description: Find points of interest along a route — useful for finding fuel stations, restaurants, or ATMs on the way from A to B. Requires the encoded polyline from get_directions.

buffer.description: Search buffer in metres on each side of the route (default 300)

category.description: POI category code (e.g. 'FODCOF' for food & coffee, 'FINATM' for ATMs, 'PETPTM' for petrol pumps)

path.description: Encoded polyline geometry string (from the 'geometry' field of get_directions response)

name: poi_along_route
